connectome.calyx_filter: Membership of the circuit is decided by connectivity, not nomenclature: a PN is kept iff it has >=1 traced synapse onto a KC, and a KC is kept iff >=1 PN reaches it. The loose '"PN" in type' test over-includes non-calyx projection neurons - 140 of the 166 mPN (multiglomerular, lateral-horn-projecting) neurons and all 91 WEDPN* (wedge) neurons have zero KC output.
